title: 34 ## Explosives & Explosive Substances Act 1.7.7. A total of 3,477 offences was registered under the Explosives and Explosive substances Act during 1983 as against 3,071 offences in 1982 registering an increase of 13.2 per cent. in 1983 over 1982. The main contributors to these cases were Uttar Pradesh (816), Bihar (595), West Bengal (509), Assafn (386), Maharashtra (220) Andhra Pradesh (208) and Madhya Pradesh (178) out of total 3,477 offences registered in the country only 52 cases were registered in all the UTs taken together. Among the Metropolitan cities Bombay, registered highest number (265) of these cases followed by Calcutta (109) cases.
